records.jp: ……海って、広い
records.en_original: The sea is truly immense...
records.en_auxiliary: The sea is truly immense...
records.en: The sea is truly immense...

records.jp: キラキラして眩しくて、穏やかで。<CR>……でも、潜れば暗くて深い、息も出来ない
records.en_original: Though it glitters in the sunlight, it is also deep and precarious, suffocating and dark...
records.en_auxiliary: Though it glitters in the sunlight, it is also deep and precarious, suffocating and dark...
records.en: It sparkles brightly and seems calm...<CR>But dive below the surface and it's dark, deep, and you can't breathe.

records.jp: まるで、人の心みたい
records.en_original: Just like the human heart...
records.en_auxiliary: Just like the human heart...
records.en: Just like the human heart...

records.jp: きららの海は綺麗なんだろうね
records.en_original: If the heart is a sea, I'm sure yours is beautiful.
records.en_auxiliary: If the heart is a sea, I'm sure yours is beautiful.
records.en: Kirara's sea must be beautiful.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: だって、きららって自分に正直っていうかさ。<CR>すごく純粋な感じがするから
records.en_original: I mean, you're always so honest with yourself. You seem so pure.
records.en_auxiliary: I mean, you're always so honest with yourself. You seem so pure.
records.en: Because you're honest with yourself, Kirara.<CR>You seem incredibly pure.

records.jp: きららの心が海になったら、どこまでも<CR>透き通るような海になるんじゃないかなー
records.en_original: I bet your heart is like a crystal clear tropical sea!
records.en_auxiliary: I bet your heart is like a crystal clear tropical sea!
records.en: If your heart became an ocean,<CR>I think it would be clear as far as the eye could see.

records.jp: ……そんなことない。<CR>きららの海、そんなに綺麗じゃない。
records.en_original: ...I don't believe my heart is that pure.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I don't believe my heart is that pure.
records.en: ...That is not true.<CR>Kirara's sea is not that beautiful.

records.jp: 神様がいないきららの海じゃ……<CR>船はいつまでたっても、目的地に着けない
records.en_original: Without the Divine, any boat that dared to set sail upon my sea would never reach its destination.
records.en_auxiliary: Without the Divine, any boat that dared to set sail upon my sea would never reach its destination.
records.en: On Kirara's sea without the Divine... a ship<CR>would never reach its destination.

records.jp: ……でもさ。勇気を出して船を出さなきゃ<CR>新しい場所にはたどり着けないよ
records.en_original: But if you never work up the courage to set sail, you'll never reach anywhere new at all.
records.en_auxiliary: But if you never work up the courage to set sail, you'll never reach anywhere new at all.
records.en: But if you never work up the courage to set sail,<CR>you'll never reach anywhere new at all.

records.jp: 危険もいっぱいあるかもだけど、それが冒険じゃん！<CR>怖くても、前に進むしかないじゃん！
records.en_original: Sure, it might be dangerous, but that's part of the journey! You'll never know if you don't start!
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, it might be dangerous, but that's part of the journey! You'll never know if you don't start!
records.en: There may be plenty of danger, but that is what makes it an adventure!<CR>Even if you're afraid, you have no choice but to move forward!

records.jp: 海って、綺麗だけど……少し怖いよね
records.en_original: The sea is beautiful...but it's pretty scary too, huh.
records.en_auxiliary: The sea is beautiful...but it's pretty scary too, huh.
records.en: The sea is beautiful...but it's pretty scary too, huh.

records.jp: ある意味では、たしかに人の心に<CR>似てるかもしれない
records.en_original: Indeed. I think it's quite a fitting metaphor for a person's heart.
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed. I think it's quite a fitting metaphor for a person's heart.
records.en: Indeed.<CR>I think it's quite a fitting metaphor for a person's heart.

records.jp: もっともっとって手を伸ばせば、<CR>暗い闇に飲み込まれてしまうこともある
records.en_original: Sometimes it feels like if you reach out too far, the darkness will swallow you whole.
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes it feels like if you reach out too far, the darkness will swallow you whole.
records.en: If you keep reaching for more<CR>and more, the dark depths may swallow you.

records.jp: うん、そう。そんな感じ
records.en_original: Yeah. I get that feeling.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I get that feeling.
records.en: Yeah. I get that feeling.

records.jp: あ……でもさ。勇気を出して潜ってみたら<CR>お宝が、見つかるかもしれないじゃん！
records.en_original: But if you work up the courage and dive down deep, you might find treasure!
records.en_auxiliary: But if you work up the courage and dive down deep, you might find treasure!
records.en: Ah... But if you work up the courage to dive,<CR>you might find treasure!

records.jp: 謎の海底神殿とか、別の世界への入り口とかあるかも！
records.en_original: Or like, the entrance to some underwater city or another world entirely!
records.en_auxiliary: Or like, the entrance to some underwater city or another world entirely!
records.en: There could be a mysterious undersea temple, or an entrance to another world!

records.jp: ふおぉぉぉぉ……！
records.en_original: Ooooh!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooooh!
records.en: Ooooh!

records.jp: 今の私たちが、まさにそうだよね。<CR>記憶を取り戻すため、元の世界に戻るため……
records.en_original: We're like voyagers on the sea. Traversing danger in order to get our memories back and return home...
records.en_auxiliary: We're like voyagers on the sea. Traversing danger in order to get our memories back and return home...
records.en: That's exactly what we're doing now.<CR>Recovering our memories and returning to our world...

records.jp: 皆と一緒なら、深い闇の中だって<CR>荒れ狂う海だって、きっと乗り越えていけるよ！
records.en_original: But if we all work together, I know we can overcome the darkest depths or the stormiest seas!
records.en_auxiliary: But if we all work together, I know we can overcome the darkest depths or the stormiest seas!
records.en: If we're all together,<CR>I know we can overcome even the deepest darkness or the wildest sea!

records.jp: ……でも、もし。<CR>きららだけ、乗り越えられなかったら？
records.en_original: But... What if I'm the only one who can't?
records.en_auxiliary: But... What if I'm the only one who can't?
records.en: ...But what<CR>if Kirara is the only one who cannot overcome it?

records.jp: 私が、きららの手を引くよ。<CR>壁の上まで、引っ張ってあげるから
records.en_original: I'll be right here, ready to lend you a hand and pull you up with me.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll be right here, ready to lend you a hand and pull you up with me.
records.en: I'll take your hand, Kirara.<CR>I'll pull you all the way over the wall.

records.jp: ……ほんと？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: うん！　一人で乗り越える必要なんてない。<CR>一緒に行こう、きらら
records.en_original: Really! There's nothing you have to try and overcome alone. I'll be by your side if you ever need me.
records.en_auxiliary: Really! There's nothing you have to try and overcome alone. I'll be by your side if you ever need me.
records.en: Yeah! You don't need to overcome it alone.<CR>Let's go together, Kirara.

records.jp: ……うん。ありがとう、愛央
records.en_original: Thank you, Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Ao...
records.en: Thank you, Ao...

records.jp: 乗り越えるまで、私が支えるよ。<CR>きららの後ろにいて、背中を押してあげる
records.en_original: Then I'll be cheering you on until you can! I'll be right behind you, pushing you forward.
records.en_auxiliary: Then I'll be cheering you on until you can! I'll be right behind you, pushing you forward.
records.en: I'll support you until you make<CR>it over. I'll stay behind you and push you forward.

records.jp: きららの、後ろに？
records.en_original: Behind me?
records.en_auxiliary: Behind me?
records.en: Behind Kirara?

records.jp: そう。私が後ろにいれば、安心でしょ？<CR>もしも倒れても、支えてあげられるし
records.en_original: Of course! That way I can catch you if you fall.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course! That way I can catch you if you fall.
records.en: Right. You'll feel safer with me behind you, won't you?<CR>And if you fall, I can catch you.

records.jp: うん……でも。<CR>後ろにいたら、愛央の顔が見れない
records.en_original: That's true, but... I won't be able to see your face if you're behind me.
records.en_auxiliary: That's true, but... I won't be able to see your face if you're behind me.
records.en: Yes...<CR>But if you're behind Kirara, she cannot see your face.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh? Did you say something?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Did you say something?
records.en: Huh? Did you say something?

records.jp: な、なんでもない……
records.en_original: I-it's nothing...
records.en_auxiliary: I-it's nothing...
records.en: I-it's nothing...

records.jp: でも、どうして急に海の話なんて？
records.en_original: What's with all this sea talk all of a sudden anyway?
records.en_auxiliary: What's with all this sea talk all of a sudden anyway?
records.en: What's with all this sea talk all of a sudden anyway?

records.jp: きららの村、海なかったから……<CR>こんなに大きな海、初めて見た
records.en_original: I grew up far away from the sea. This is the first time I've ever seen so much water.
records.en_auxiliary: I grew up far away from the sea. This is the first time I've ever seen so much water.
records.en: Kirara's village had no sea...<CR>This is the first time Kirara has seen one this large.

records.jp: あーなるほど。でも、これって海なのかなあ。<CR>海って言ったら、やっぱり砂浜じゃね？
records.en_original: Ahh, gotcha. Doesn't feel like the sea to me without a beach.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, gotcha. Doesn't feel like the sea to me without a beach.
records.en: Ahh, I get it. But is this really the sea?<CR>When I think of the sea, I think of a beach.

records.jp: ひと夏のアバンチュール……
records.en_original: Like a tropical getaway...
records.en_auxiliary: Like a tropical getaway...
records.en: A summer fling...

records.jp: そうそう、トロピカルジュースとかね！
records.en_original: Exactly! With an ice cold glass of tropical juice!
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly! With an ice cold glass of tropical juice!
records.en: Exactly, and tropical juice!

records.jp: いいな……砂浜、見てみたい
records.en_original: How nice... I'd love to see one like that someday.
records.en_auxiliary: How nice... I'd love to see one like that someday.
records.en: How nice... Kirara wants to see a beach.

records.jp: 一緒に見に行こうよ
records.en_original: We should go together!
records.en_auxiliary: We should go together!
records.en: We should go together!

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ひと夏のアバンチュール。<CR>二人でしてみない？
records.en_original: We can have our own little summer getaway!
records.en_auxiliary: We can have our own little summer getaway!
records.en: A summer fling.<CR>Want to have one together?

records.jp: つまりそれは……<CR>きららと、火遊びをしたいということ？
records.en_original: Does that mean...you'd want to see fireworks with me as well?
records.en_auxiliary: Does that mean...you'd want to see fireworks with me as well?
records.en: In other words...<CR>you want to play with fire with Kirara?

records.jp: したいということですな
records.en_original: I suppose it does mean that, yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose it does mean that, yeah.
records.en: That is exactly what I mean.

records.jp: うむ。よかろう。<CR>その誘い、受けて立つ
records.en_original: Is that so. Very well, I shall accept your invitation.
records.en_auxiliary: Is that so. Very well, I shall accept your invitation.
records.en: Is that so. Very well,<CR>I shall accept your invitation.

records.jp: あはは、やったね！
records.en_original: Ahaha, awesome!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, awesome!
records.en: Ahaha, awesome!

records.jp: ……いつ、行けるのかは分かんないけどさ。<CR>見に行こうね、本物の海！
records.en_original: I dunno when we'll be able to go, but it's a promise. We'll see the real ocean one day!
records.en_auxiliary: I dunno when we'll be able to go, but it's a promise. We'll see the real ocean one day!
records.en: I don't know when we'll be able to go...<CR>but let's see the real sea together!

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: ...Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes.
records.en: ...Yes.

records.jp: ……そだね。砂浜、見れたらいいね
records.en_original: Yeah... I hope you get to one day.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I hope you get to one day.
records.en: ...Yeah. I hope you get to see a beach.

records.en_original: ...Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes.
records.en: ...Yes.

records.jp: もし、きららたちが、元の世界に戻れたら<CR>その時は、愛央と……
records.en_original: When we return to our world maybe we could...
records.en_auxiliary: When we return to our world maybe we could...
records.en: If Kirara and the others return to the original world...<CR>then Kirara and Ao...

records.jp: え、なに？
records.en_original: Hm?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm?
records.en: Hm?

records.jp: なんでもない。ただの独り言
records.en_original: It's nothing. Just talking to myself.
records.en_auxiliary: It's nothing. Just talking to myself.
records.en: It's nothing. Just talking to myself.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
